reasoning: Recent state-specific polling in Iowa’s 2026 U.S. Senate race shows a very close contest, with the latest Emerson College poll giving Republican Ashley Hinson a 2.5-point lead over Democrat Josh Turek and the NYT/Siena poll giving Hinson a 2-point lead; an earlier Fox News/Beacon poll had Turek ahead by 4 points, so the race is best described as currently R+ about 2 to 3 points. Iowa’s statewide Cook PVI is R+6, which provides the structural Republican lean behind that polling picture.

sources.name: Emerson College Polling/Nexstar via CBS2 Iowa
sources.details: Emerson College Polling/Nexstar survey of 712 likely Iowa voters found Ashley Hinson at 47.5% and Josh Turek at 45.0%, a Hinson lead within the margin of error.

sources.name: New York Times / Siena College via The Hill
sources.details: The New York Times/Siena College poll of 600 likely Iowa voters found Ashley Hinson ahead of Josh Turek 48% to 46%.

sources.name: Fox News / Beacon Research via The Hill
sources.details: Fox News/Beacon Research poll of 1,003 registered voters found Josh Turek ahead of Ashley Hinson 50% to 46%.

sources.name: Pollsmax Iowa Senate Forecast
sources.details: Polling average across recent Iowa Senate polls shows Ashley Hinson ahead by 3.6 points.
